_readme: 目录内容。新增一个 app：把它放进 incubator/<文件夹>/，再在 items 里加一条。status: ready 可用 / incubating 孵化中 / planned 规划中。cover 可留空。 detail 可选：鼠标在卡片上停 3 秒（触屏点 ⓘ）显示的详细介绍——subtitle，sections[{h, lead（触屏分页时每页的大标题，可省略）, body:[{p}|{list}]}]，文字里 **粗体**。 parked：暂不在目录显示、但文件夹保留待用的 app（原条目加 parked 说明）；移回 items 即可恢复显示。

desc.zh: 伦敦全域 → 区域划分 → Wool 区域路网 → Tensor 局部道路 → 路网整合与导出。
desc.en: Greater London → regions → Wool regional network → Tensor local streets → integration & export.

title.zh: 伦敦地图 · 真实数据

desc.zh: 伦敦 70 km 范围的真实地理数据：OSM 底图与 3D 建筑，EA LiDAR 地形、地形着色与 3D 地形起伏、EA 洪水风险、由 OS Terrain 50 推导的排水网络，以及绿带、AONB、按服务分类的铁路和 HS1/HS2；可切换颜色主题、光照、天气，搜索地点。
desc.en: Real geographic data for London within 70 km: the OSM basemap and 3D buildings, EA LiDAR terrain, colour by height and 3D relief, EA flood risk, a drainage network derived from OS Terrain 50, the Green Belt, AONB, rail by service and HS1/HS2; colour themes, lighting, weather and place search.

lead.zh: 一个由地形、水文与建成环境约束的连续场域
lead.en: A continuous field, held by terrain, water and the built city

p.zh: 本项目以 70 km 研究半径界定大伦敦的地域范围，把城市看作由地形、水文与既有建成环境共同约束的连续场域，而不是一块可以随意书写的空白基地。这张地图是整个多尺度生成系统的基准层：之后每一级生成，都从这里读取真实条件，再回到这里接受检验。
p.en: The project defines Greater London through a 70 km study radius and reads the city as a continuous field constrained by topography, hydrology and the existing built environment, rather than a blank site open to any inscription. This map is the datum of the whole multi-scale generative system: every subsequent level of generation reads its real conditions from here, and returns here to be tested.

lead.zh: 四层真实数据，叠合成同一个基准
lead.en: Four layers of real data, one datum

list.zh: **建成环境**：OpenStreetMap 街道网络与三维建筑体量，叠加随太阳位置实时计算的阴影
list.en: **Built environment**: the OpenStreetMap street network and three-dimensional building massing, with shadows computed live from the sun's position

list.zh: **地形**：英国环境署（EA）LiDAR 1 m 数字地形模型
list.en: **Topography**: the Environment Agency (EA) LiDAR 1 m digital terrain model

list.zh: **水文**：由 OS Terrain 50 推导的汇水面积与排水网络，揭示地表径流的潜在路径
list.en: **Hydrology**: contributing area and the drainage network derived from OS Terrain 50, revealing the latent paths of surface run-off

list.zh: **风险**：EA 当前洪水风险，分综合、地表水、河流与海洋三类来源
list.en: **Risk**: the EA's present-day flood risk, from three sources — combined, surface water, and rivers and sea

lead.zh: 从现存肌理中生长出来的街道
lead.en: Streets grown out of the existing fabric

p.zh: 在地图上划定地块边界，系统会把该范围内的街道、水体、建筑与地形一并移交给张量场工作室，作为局部街道生成的初始条件。新生成的路网默认绕开既有建筑，使生成过程从现存城市的肌理中生长出来。
p.en: Drawing a site boundary on the map hands its streets, water, buildings and terrain to Tensor Studio as the initial conditions for local street generation. The new network routes around existing buildings by default, so that generation grows out of the fabric of the city as it stands.

title.zh: Loop City · 1 整环：黏菌与生长
title.en: Loop City · 1 The whole loop: mould and growth

desc.zh: 第 1 步：黏菌与城市生长在整条环线上同时运行（2025–2100），读取现有的高速公路和 A 级道路，得出干净的单元；选一个或多个单元，交给毛线带。
desc.en: Step 1: the slime mould and the city growth run together over the whole loop (2025-2100), reading the existing motorways and A roads, and give clean cells; pick one or several and hand them to the wool bands.

detail.subtitle: Loop City · Step 1 · A Loop to Grow Along

lead.zh: 让伦敦沿着一条环线生长，而不是继续向外摊开
lead.en: London grown along a loop, not spread further outwards

p.zh: 在绿带之外修一条 412 km 的地面环线和 17 个车站，把未来的增长引到车站周围。城市怎样沿环线长出来，不是画出来的：让黏菌从车站出发，与城市一起从 2025 年长到 2100 年。黏菌在这里是一种寻找高效网络的模型，它留下的主干就是新城区的骨架。
p.en: A 412 km loop above ground and 17 stations, beyond the Green Belt, draw future growth to the stations. How the city grows along it is not drawn by hand: a slime mould is released at the stations and grows with the city from 2025 to 2100. Here the mould is a model of how an efficient network finds itself; the trunks it leaves become the frame of the new districts.

lead.zh: 四层数据，叠在同一张图上

list.zh: **铁路**：六条放射线沿真实线路（OpenStreetMap 轨道），用官方线路名；321 km 隧道高速环线连接 6 个一级站；412 km 地面中速环线串起全部 17 个车站（6 个一级站、8 个二级站、3 个机场站）
list.en: **Rail**: six radials on real lines (OpenStreetMap track), under their official names; a 321 km high-speed loop in tunnel joins the 6 primary stations; a 412 km medium-speed loop above ground runs through all 17 (6 primary, 8 secondary, 3 for the airports)

list.zh: **现有道路**：OS Open Zoomstack 的高速公路、A 级路和干线，黏菌会沿着它们走
list.en: **Existing roads**: motorways, A roads and trunk routes from OS Open Zoomstack, which the mould follows

list.zh: **保护用地**：绿带、杰出自然风景区（AONB）与国家公园（Natural England）
list.en: **Protected land**: the Green Belt, Areas of Outstanding Natural Beauty and the national parks (Natural England)

list.zh: **土壤**：农业用地分级（Natural England），决定农田落在哪里
list.en: **Soil**: the Agricultural Land Classification (Natural England), which decides where farming goes

lead.zh: 黏菌与城市一起长一百年
lead.en: The mould and the city, grown together for a century

p.zh: 点「运行百年」，黏菌从 17 个车站出发，城市、农田和道路随它逐年生长。铁路两侧留出自由走廊，越往伦敦方向地面对黏菌越不利，所以它沿环线成网，不长进伦敦。百年结束后，从黏菌的干道读出一个个单元：每次运行都不同，因为黏菌没有固定的随机种子。
p.en: Press Run the century: the mould sets out from the 17 stations and the city, its farming and its roads grow with it year by year. A free corridor runs either side of the rail, and the ground turns against the mould towards London, so it makes a net along the loop and stays out of the city. When the century ends, cells are read from the mould’s highways; every run is different, as the mould has no fixed random seed.

lead.zh: 选一个单元，送往第 2 步
lead.en: Choose a cell, send it to step 2

p.zh: 在地图上选一个或几个单元，送往第 2 步毛线带。之后依次是张量场工作室和结构工作室：从整条环线一直落到街道和结构。
p.en: Choose one cell or several on the map and send them to step 2, the wool bands; then Tensor Studio and Structure Studio: from the whole loop down to the streets and the structure.

desc.zh: 第 2 步：在所选单元上分 17 个步骤，从锚点和毛线得到接上现有道路的路网、按间距分级的道路（真实宽度）和按用途划分的地块；选出城区地块，直接交给张量场工作室。
desc.en: Step 2: on the picked cells, 17 steps from anchors and wool to a network joined to the existing roads, a road hierarchy by spacing at true widths, and parcels by use; pick urban parcels and hand them straight to Tensor Studio.

desc.zh: 由等高线、全年风场与吸引点叠加成张量场，从锚点生长主路与次路；按主干路 / 次干路 / 支路三级、真实车行道宽度和逐个路口的路缘倒角成图，可在伦敦地图上任选场地，并导出正式路网。
desc.en: Contour, a year of wind and attractors add up to a tensor field; main and second streets grow from anchors and are drawn as a real city's: three grades at real carriageway widths, kerbs fitted junction by junction, on any London site, with the network exported as built.

detail.subtitle: Tensor Studio · Streets from an Environmental Field

lead.zh: 让街道的走向，从地形、气候和水里推出来
lead.en: Streets whose direction comes from the terrain, the climate and the water

p.zh: 地块有了，街道往哪走？这里不画路网：把地形、全年风、夏季风、冬季冷风和水各自写成一张方向场，叠成张量场，街道沿着它生长。和常见的叠图分析不同，这里叠在一起的不是土地好坏的数值，而是方向；街道生长所沿的场，也不是网格、放射这类几何图形，而是由环境数据得出的。
p.en: With the plots in hand, which way should the streets run? They are not drawn: the terrain, the year’s wind, the summer air, the winter cold and the water each become a field of directions, added into one tensor field, and the streets grow along it. Unlike the usual overlay analysis, what is laid over each other is direction, not how good the land is; and the field the streets grow along is not a geometric figure such as a grid or a radial, but one taken from the environment.

lead.zh: 五层环境数据，各给出一个方向
lead.en: Five layers of the environment, each giving a direction

list.zh: **地形**：车站 P2 由 1 m 等高线重建，伦敦其他选区用 OS Terrain 50；道路顺等高线，坡越陡越要顺
list.en: **Terrain**: rebuilt from 1 m contours at station P2, OS Terrain 50 elsewhere in London; streets follow the contours, the more so the steeper

list.zh: **全年风**：London Luton 典型气象年，逐月风玫瑰；温和的方向顺着，寒冷的方向横切
list.en: **The year’s wind**: the London Luton typical meteorological year, month by month; along the mild directions, across the cold ones

list.zh: **夏季风与冬季冷风**：同一份风数据里的夏季风能和冬季冷风；顺夏风为通风，横切冷风为挡风
list.en: **Summer air and winter cold**: the summer wind energy and the cold winter wind from the same record; along the summer air for ventilation, across the cold for shelter

list.zh: **水**：英国环境署洪水风险，地表水与河流海洋逐格取较高等级；高风险区留作蓝绿走廊，道路顺水流
list.en: **Water**: the Environment Agency’s flood risk, the higher of surface water and rivers and sea; high-risk land stays a blue-green corridor, and streets follow the flow

list.zh: **吸引点**：放在全年风互相抵消、最平静的地方，道路向它们汇聚
list.en: **Attractors**: placed where the year’s winds cancel and the air is calmest; the streets gather towards them

lead.zh: 张量相加，街道沿场长出
lead.en: Tensors added; streets grow along the field

p.zh: 场地切成 10 m 网格。每个点上，各层的方向写成二阶对称张量相加——路没有正反，角度不能直接平均——再平滑 40 m。主方向长主路，与它垂直的方向长次路，从现有道路与红线的交点出发。清晰度和冲突是可以度量的读数：各层一致处道路平直，相左处转折。同一块地四组输入的对照里，每加一层，平均清晰度从 0.63 降到 0.53、0.30。
p.en: The site becomes a 10 m grid. At every point each layer’s direction is written as a symmetric second-order tensor and the tensors are added — a street has no arrow, so angles cannot simply be averaged — then smoothed over 40 m. The major direction grows the main streets, the one square to it the second streets, from where existing roads meet the red line. Clarity and conflict are measured readings: where the layers agree the streets run straight; where they disagree, they turn. Grown four times on the same site, each layer added lowers the mean clarity, from 0.63 to 0.53 to 0.30.

lead.zh: 成为真实的城市道路，交给结构工作室
lead.en: Built as real streets, handed to Structure Studio

p.zh: 按主干路 / 次干路 / 支路三级、真实车行道宽度和逐个路口的路缘倒角成图；跨过蓝绿走廊的道路近乎垂直，作为堤道。可在伦敦地图上任选场地运行，导出 GeoJSON（英国国家网格）。结果交给结构工作室，在街道之上生成 Linear Farm 走廊。打开时的原理短片，就是把这一页动起来讲。
p.en: Drawn as a city’s streets: three grades at real carriageway widths, kerbs fitted junction by junction; streets cross the blue-green corridors nearly square, as causeways. Runs on any site chosen on the London map and exports GeoJSON (British National Grid). The result goes to Structure Studio, which raises the Linear Farm corridors over the streets. The film at the opening tells this page in motion.

title.zh: 结构工作室 · Linear Farm 走廊

desc.zh: 在张量场工作室生成的真实场地上，生成架在街道之上的种植工厂走廊网：离路主线顺张量场、核心密外围疏、按夹角光滑过渡的节点，两侧建筑、室内农田；导出 GeoJSON（英国国家网格）与 OBJ。
desc.en: Planting-factory corridors over a site grown in Tensor Studio: off-road primaries along the tensor field, dense at the cores and open at the edge, nodes blended by their angle, buildings on both sides and farmland in the cells; exported as GeoJSON (British National Grid) and OBJ.

detail.subtitle: Structure Studio · Linear Farm Corridors over the Streets

lead.zh: 一张架在街道之上的种植工厂走廊网
lead.en: A network of planting-factory corridors, raised over the streets

p.zh: 张量场工作室长出了地面上的街道，结构工作室在它上面再长一张网：15–25 m 宽的 Linear Farm 走廊，里面是种植工厂，走廊围出的地块是农田。如果直接把主干路加宽成走廊，得到的只是一块块街区——加宽的街道；所以这里从同一个张量场推出第二张网，离开道路，跨过街道、水面和铁路。形态取自湿线找形：浸湿的线会自己并拢成束，节点成三岔。
p.en: Tensor Studio grows the streets on the ground; Structure Studio grows a second net above them: Linear Farm corridors 15–25 m wide with planting factories inside, and farmland in the cells between. Widening the main streets into corridors would give only blocks — wider streets; so a second net is drawn from the same tensor field, off the roads, bridging streets, water and rail. Its form comes from wet-thread form-finding: wet threads draw together into bundles and meet in three-way nodes.

lead.zh: 张量场工作室的结果，就是它的场地
lead.en: Tensor Studio’s result is its site

list.zh: **张量场与街道**：张量场工作室第 8 步的结果——三级道路、路口、吸引点和场本身
list.en: **Field and streets**: Tensor Studio’s finished result — the three grades of street, the junctions, the attractors and the field itself

list.zh: **水与地面**：水面、场地红线，以及红线外的现状建筑、道路和建成区
list.en: **Water and ground**: the water, the red line, and the existing buildings, roads and built-up land beyond it

list.zh: **核心**：张量场的主吸引点；走廊在这里密，往外疏
list.en: **Cores**: the field’s main attractors; the corridors are dense there and open out towards the edge

list.zh: **模块**：Linear Farm 的 Rhino 模型——双 U 形走道、两层坡道、漏斗柱与种植托盘，层高 3.6 m
list.en: **The module**: the Linear Farm Rhino model — twin U-channel walkways, two-level ramps, funnel columns and planting trays, 3.6 m a storey

lead.zh: 五步定平面，第六步立起来
lead.en: Five steps for the plan, a sixth to raise it

p.zh: 平面分五步：核心与疏密、离路主线、拉扯、走廊与节点、方案（换随机种子比较多个方案，按五组指标打分）。第 6 步按真实标高立成三维：全网两层走道在 7.2 m 和 11.8 m，大塔 200 m 内升到第三层 16.4 m（板厚 1 m，层间净高 3.6 m），坡道把各层缝在一起；每个核心立一座种植塔，站在三叶形的三层塔座上，塔尖约 186 m。张量场的道路一条不动，从结构下面穿过。
p.en: The plan comes in five steps: cores and density, off-road primaries, pull, corridors and nodes, and scheme (many random seeds compared and ranked on five measures). Step 6 raises it at real levels: two decks across the net at 7.2 m and 11.8 m, a third at 16.4 m within 200 m of the large towers (1 m slabs, 3.6 m clear between them), ramps stitching the levels together; on each core a planting tower stands on a three-lobed, three-tier base, about 186 m to the tip. Every tensor-field street passes underneath, untouched.

lead.zh: 叠回伦敦地图，进入 Rhino
lead.en: Back onto the London map, into Rhino

p.zh: 导出 GeoJSON（英国国家网格，可直接叠回伦敦地图）、OBJ（Rhino）、JSON 和平面 PNG。规则对任何场地成立：从张量场工作室取另一块场地的结果，就能在伦敦的其他地方生成。沿走廊的建筑之后单独做成一个功能。
p.en: Exports GeoJSON (British National Grid, straight back onto the London map), OBJ for Rhino, JSON and a plan PNG. The rules hold on any site: take another site’s result from Tensor Studio and the corridors grow elsewhere in London. Buildings along the corridors come later, as a feature of their own.

desc.zh: 把伦敦地图、地形、洪水风险和汇水网络变成可以走进去的三维沙盘：在电脑上预览，戴上 Meta Quest 3S 进入 VR 展厅，在空间里走动，拖动、旋转、缩放桌上的伦敦，开关洪水风险、汇水网络和建筑，点屏幕查看项目内容，也可以按 1:1 走进城市。
desc.en: The London map, terrain, flood risk and drainage as a 3D model you can walk into: preview it on the desktop; on a Meta Quest 3S enter the VR gallery, walk around, slide, turn and zoom London on the table, switch flood risk, drainage and buildings, open the screens for the project, or walk the city at 1:1.

desc.zh: 三个协同工作的页面：整个环线上的黏菌与单元、单元内的毛线与道路等级，以及张量场底图。
desc.en: Three pages that work together: the slime mould and its cells over the whole loop, the wool and the road hierarchy inside the cells, and the base for the tensor field.

parked.zh: 暂不在目录显示，文件夹保留待用。新版见 loop-city-wool-bands；本版保留放大后的车道与路口细节（真实宽度的道路、公交专用道、自行车道、人行道）和胶囊站点，以后可能并入道路功能。
parked.en: Not shown in the catalogue for now; the folder is kept for later use. The newer version is loop-city-wool-bands; this one keeps the lane and junction detail when zoomed in (roads at true width, bus lanes, cycle tracks, footways) and the capsule stops, which may be brought into the road functions later.

title.zh: 城市生长模拟 · 整条环线

desc.zh: 2025–2100 年沿 412 公里环线的城市生长，50 米地块，2100 年 12,222,179 人；用滑块改变吸引点、噪声场与农业规则，以相同目标重新生长并对比。
desc.en: City growth along the 412 km loop, 2025–2100, on 50 m parcels: 12,222,179 people by 2100. Sliders change the magnets, noise fields and farming, and the city grows again to the same targets.

lead.zh: 城市是一个过程，而不是一张蓝图
lead.en: The city as a process, not a masterplan

p.zh: 本项目把 Loop City 的城市化看作一个随时间展开的过程，而不是一张终极蓝图。模拟沿 412 km 的环线展开，时间跨度为 2025–2100 年，以 50 m 地块为基本单元，追踪人口、建成区与农业用地在七十五年间如何相互竞争、彼此置换。
p.en: The project treats the urbanisation of Loop City as a process unfolding in time rather than a final masterplan. The simulation runs along the 412 km orbital loop from 2025 to 2100, on 50 m parcels as its basic unit, tracing how population, built fabric and farmland compete with and displace one another over seventy-five years.

lead.zh: 三种力，与一片共同演化的农田
lead.en: Three forces, and a farmland that co-evolves

p.zh: 城市的增长由三类力共同驱动：
p.en: Growth is driven by three kinds of force:

list.zh: 车站作为**吸引点**
list.en: the stations as **magnets**

list.zh: **FIELD** 与 **VEIN** 两种噪声场引入的空间差异
list.en: the spatial variation introduced by two noise fields, **FIELD** and **VEIN**

list.zh: 以车站为中心的**密度环**
list.en: **density rings** centred on the stations

p.zh: 农业规则则在同一张地块网格上为生产性景观保留空间，使城市与农田作为同一系统中的两种状态共同演化。
p.en: Farming rules reserve room for a productive landscape on the same parcel grid, so that city and farmland co-evolve as two states of one system.

lead.zh: 哪些规则，产生了哪些形态

p.zh: 系统允许调整各项驱动参数，并在**相同人口目标**下重新生长。总量不变，只改规则，城市形态之间的差异由此直接对应到规则上。这让模拟从单一预测变成一种比较性的设计工具：研究对象不再是「城市会长成什么样」，而是「哪些规则产生了哪些形态」。
p.en: Each driver can be adjusted and the city regrown to the **same population target**. With the totals held and only the rules changed, differences in urban form map directly onto the rules. The simulation thus shifts from a single forecast to a comparative design instrument: the question is no longer "what will the city become" but "which rules produce which forms".

parked.zh: 暂不在目录显示，文件夹保留：「城市生长」模块（modules/01-growth-simulator）读这里的引擎、设置和数据，不能删除。该模块 2026-11-23 起不再出现在主程序导航中（由 Loop City 第 1 步取代），代码和测试仍在仓库里。城市生长与调规则的滑块在 Loop City · 1 整环里也有；本 app 独有的是固定可复现的发布结果（种子 42）、变体与最终结果的对比、生成流程的分步讲解。直接链接仍可打开。
parked.en: Not shown in the catalogue for now; the folder stays: the growth module (modules/01-growth-simulator) reads the engine, settings and data here, so it must not be deleted. Since 2026-11-23 that module is no longer in the main program's nav (Loop City step 1 took its place); its code and tests are still in the repository. City growth and its rule sliders are also in Loop City · 1 whole loop; what only this app has is the fixed, repeatable release run (seed 42), the comparison of a variation with the final, and the step-by-step account of how the city is made. It still opens by its direct link.
